2c83b1af-40b7-45e3-8ab0-c610eabe0574/Eve.en: The morning dew in the mountains has not yet dried, the chill congeals on the thatched eaves...<NL>The departing footsteps are about to step into the morning light beyond the mountains...
2c83b1af-40b7-45e3-8ab0-c610eabe0574/Eve.cn: 山间朝露未晞，寒意凝于茅檐……<NL>离去的脚步，即将踏入那山外的晨光之中……
2c83b1af-40b7-45e3-8ab0-c610eabe0574/Eve.ru: Утренняя роса в горах еще не высохла, холод застывает на крытых соломой карнизах...<NL>Удаляющиеся шаги вот-вот выйдут в утренний свет за горами...

2c83b1af-40b7-45e3-8ab0-c610eabe0574/Opt.en: (Follow the will of heaven, and part here...)
(Stay a while longer, do not leave yet...)

e1362b94-d9b6-4950-b401-b8520bb2a738/Eve.en: White dew has soaked the flowers and grass, and the weather turns clear and high.<NL>In the early morning, you collect the purest droplets from leaf tips to brew tea.<NL>This purest water is what reveals the true flavor of autumn.
e1362b94-d9b6-4950-b401-b8520bb2a738/Eve.cn: 白露沾湿了花丛与草叶，天气转为清朗高远。<NL>你在清晨收集叶尖最纯净的凝露，用以煎茶。<NL>这至清至纯的水，方能冲泡出秋日的本味。

32fd8620-c41f-497e-91bb-1a127b48d00f/Eve.ru: Теперь ты понимаешь, не так ли?

1ee8fca4-472b-4ce1-ba4f-d896b117cbb6/Eve.en: White dew condenses upon blades of grass, and dawn light pierces through the treetops...<NL>Arriving at the entrance of the encounter, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> sees morning dew hanging from petals and leaves like shattered jade.<NL>Such pure and untainted essence is the key reagent for brewing the "Trinity's Grace"...<NL>This encounter begins with the quest for dew and the brewing of tea...
1ee8fca4-472b-4ce1-ba4f-d896b117cbb6/Eve.cn: 白露凝霜沾草叶，天光破晓透林梢……<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>行至奇遇入口，见晨露坠于花叶间，晶莹如碎玉，<NL>此等至清至纯之物，恰是酿造“三才润露”的关键引子……<NL>今番奇遇，便从寻露煎茶始……

1ee8fca4-472b-4ce1-ba4f-d896b117cbb6/Opt.en: (Since this opportunity has come, I shall seek the truth of the nourishing dew...)
1ee8fca4-472b-4ce1-ba4f-d896b117cbb6/Opt.cn: （既遇此机缘，当往寻润露真意……）
1ee8fca4-472b-4ce1-ba4f-d896b117cbb6/Opt.ru: (Раз уж представилась такая возможность, я буду искать истину о питательной росе...)

66d72dac-114a-4d77-b75a-60c12c772ee1/Eve.en: The elder straightens up with difficulty, points to the plants ahead, and explains: <NL>"The dew of the Wild Chrysanthemum, bitter and fragrant, cuts through grease and cleanses the throat; <NL>the dew on bamboo leaves facing east, touched by the spiritual light of the sky, can cleanse the eyes; <NL>the frost-defying dew of the Cotton Rose, rich and proud, is best for refreshing the spirit..." <NL>With that, he hands over a white porcelain bottle and entrusts: <NL>"Be kind enough to retrieve these three dews for me—one drop of each will suffice!"
66d72dac-114a-4d77-b75a-60c12c772ee1/Eve.cn: 长者艰难直起身，捶腰指向前方植物，娓娓道来：<NL>“野菊之露，苦香煞正，可清喉腻；<NL>竹叶朝东之露，沾天光灵性，能洗眼目；<NL>木芙蓉拒霜之露，肥润傲岸，最能提神……”<NL>言罢递出白瓷瓶，嘱托道：<NL>“劳你为我取回这三露，一滴足矣！”

66d72dac-114a-4d77-b75a-60c12c772ee1/Opt.en: Where can these three dews be found?
66d72dac-114a-4d77-b75a-60c12c772ee1/Opt.ru: Где можно найти эти три капли росы?

be7a3bd9-5259-4b29-8da1-015d669f53f4/Eve.en: Wild chrysanthemums hold jade-like dew, their cold fragrance shimmering in the morning breeze.<NL>Here lies the Wild Chrysanthemum Dew.
be7a3bd9-5259-4b29-8da1-015d669f53f4/Eve.cn: 野菊噙玉露，寒香泫晓风。<NL>此处有野菊的露水。
be7a3bd9-5259-4b29-8da1-015d669f53f4/Eve.ru: На диких хризантемах роса, похожая на Нефрит, их холодный аромат мерцает в утреннем ветерке.<NL>Здесь лежит роса дикой хризантемы.

7f87f9c2-3032-40f3-a552-29eb8259cc4a/Eve.en: Wild chrysanthemums hold jade-like dew, their cold fragrance shimmering in the morning breeze.<NL>Here lies the Wild Chrysanthemum Dew.
7f87f9c2-3032-40f3-a552-29eb8259cc4a/Eve.cn: 野菊噙玉露，寒香泫晓风。<NL>此处有野菊的露水。
7f87f9c2-3032-40f3-a552-29eb8259cc4a/Eve.ru: На диких хризантемах роса, похожая на Нефрит, их холодный аромат мерцает в утреннем ветерке.<NL>Здесь лежит роса дикой хризантемы.

a56621c1-aa85-4d2f-b5ae-4280cc57dfb9/Eve.en: Green bamboo bears clear dew, its gentle sound like jade washed by flowing water.<NL>Here lies the Green Bamboo Dew.
a56621c1-aa85-4d2f-b5ae-4280cc57dfb9/Eve.cn: 翠竹垂清露，泠泠漱玉声。<NL>此处有翠竹的露水。
a56621c1-aa85-4d2f-b5ae-4280cc57dfb9/Eve.ru: На зеленом бамбуке блестит прозрачная роса, его нежный звук подобен Нефриту, омываемому текущей водой.<NL>Здесь лежит зеленая бамбуковая роса.

b74ab2d8-bdac-4346-952f-b4abd06175bd/Eve.en: The tea farmer takes the porcelain bottle and inspects it against the daylight. His wrinkles ease as he smiles in satisfaction:<NL>"Not a trace lacking—the ferocity of metal weapons, the gentleness of forest winds, the pride that resists frost... all three essences are present..."
b74ab2d8-bdac-4346-952f-b4abd06175bd/Eve.cn: 茶农接过瓷瓶对天光细看，皱纹舒展，欣然说道：<NL>“金戈之煞、林下之风、拒霜之傲，一滴不少，一气不泄……”

516eca4e-bd3b-4caa-9b82-32ddae79e963/Eve.en: Once the tea is poured and served, the tea farmer reminds <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>:<NL>"Careful, it is hot. This tea can soothe the throat, brighten the eyes, steady the mind—and wash away worldly dullness..."
516eca4e-bd3b-4caa-9b82-32ddae79e963/Eve.cn: 毕斟茶递出，叮嘱<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>：<NL>“当心烫，此茶可润喉、亮眼、聚神，涤尽尘俗昏沉……”

ef43aac6-77b4-42f9-83f3-2529a837c272/Eve.en: Morning dew condenses again, wetting the sleeves; old tea is re-brewed, refreshing the heart.<NL>The unfinished fate of "Trinity's Grace" is now renewed.<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> obtains trait: Trinity's Grace)</color>
ef43aac6-77b4-42f9-83f3-2529a837c272/Eve.cn: 晨露再凝沾衣袂，旧茶重煎沁心脾，<NL>先前未竟的“三才润露”之缘今又续。<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>获得特性：三才润露）</color>

6bb6d7d2-85a9-403d-8972-45902d37f138/Eve.en: The Wild Chrysanthemum Dew has been collected in the bottle...
6bb6d7d2-85a9-403d-8972-45902d37f138/Eve.cn: 野菊的露水，已掬于瓶中……
6bb6d7d2-85a9-403d-8972-45902d37f138/Eve.ru: В бутылке собрана роса дикой хризантемы...

423ab7ac-e415-486b-b14c-ea2c4e496573/Eve.en: Cotton Rose Dew has been collected in the bottle...
423ab7ac-e415-486b-b14c-ea2c4e496573/Eve.cn: 木芙蓉的露水，已掬于瓶中……
423ab7ac-e415-486b-b14c-ea2c4e496573/Eve.ru: Во флаконе собрана роса хлопковой розы...

a266c93a-8892-4fe1-922a-37329dc9aca6/Eve.en: The Green Bamboo Dew has been collected in the bottle....
a266c93a-8892-4fe1-922a-37329dc9aca6/Eve.cn: 翠竹的露水，已掬于瓶中……
a266c93a-8892-4fe1-922a-37329dc9aca6/Eve.ru: В бутылке собрана зеленая бамбуковая роса....

f82e75d3-9ac9-42fd-aa52-098dfa3c6652/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> slowly drinks the tea, feeling a slight bitterness that turns sweet, a warm current cleansing the body...<NL>All weariness vanishes, eyes bright and mind clear, breathing long and deep...<NL>The elder wipes clean the porcelain bottle and returns it, saying: <NL>"Keep this 'Tri-dew Bottle' well; it holds the nature and fate of today's three dews.<NL>When you pass this way again, show this bottle, and I will brew you a cup of 'Trinity's Grace'."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> obtains trait: Trinity's Grace)</color>
f82e75d3-9ac9-42fd-aa52-098dfa3c6652/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>缓缓饮下茶汤，只觉微苦回甘，暖流涤荡周身……<NL>倦容尽去，眼明心清，呼吸绵长……<NL>长者见状拭净瓷瓶递还，说道：<NL>“此‘三才露瓶’你且收好，盛有今日三露性气与缘分。<NL>往后途经此地，出示此瓶，老夫再为你烹一盏‘三才润露’。”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>获得特性：三才润露）</color>

4b77a10d-0b7a-4de8-a68e-f51ad764ef9f/Eve.en: Places of Energy recovery—each can only be used once.
4b77a10d-0b7a-4de8-a68e-f51ad764ef9f/Eve.cn: 恢复精力之处，每处仅可使用一次。
4b77a10d-0b7a-4de8-a68e-f51ad764ef9f/Eve.ru: Места восстановления Энергии — каждое из них можно использовать только один раз.

4b77a10d-0b7a-4de8-a68e-f51ad764ef9f/Opt.en: <color=#lightgrey>(You can no longer rest at this rest area...)</color>
4b77a10d-0b7a-4de8-a68e-f51ad764ef9f/Opt.ru: <color=#lightgrey>(Вы больше не можете отдыхать в этой зоне отдыха...)</color>

9e0cc612-3e9c-485b-b528-c2c8e9c671ae/Eve.en: A faintly red-tinged Bush, trembling in the wind; perhaps useful items can be gathered from it...
9e0cc612-3e9c-485b-b528-c2c8e9c671ae/Eve.cn: 晕染着淡红的草丛，随风轻颤，或可采集到有用之物……
9e0cc612-3e9c-485b-b528-c2c8e9c671ae/Eve.ru: Слегка окрашенный в красный цвет куст, трепещущий на ветру; возможно, с него можно собрать полезные вещи...

4e7e4d60-1d4e-4b68-881a-9908274579a9/Eve.en: The tea table has been cleared; the fire in the stove is about to die...<NL>Seeing Taiwu lingers, the tea farmer pauses mid-wipe of a clay cup.<NL>A gentle, knowing smile appears on his aged face...<NL>He sets the cup down and bows to Taiwu,<NL>his voice as gentle as an autumn stream.<NL>"Time does not wait, but bonds may be renewed. Thank you for your help.<NL>Let us part here. When the next White Dew cycle arrives, I shall still be here, awaiting my old friend,<NL>to once again share this pure taste of dew-brewed tea."
4e7e4d60-1d4e-4b68-881a-9908274579a9/Eve.cn: 茶案已净，炉火将熄……<NL>茶农见太吾复又驻足，手中擦拭陶杯的动作微微一顿，<NL>苍老的面容上浮现一抹温和了然的笑意……<NL>他放下杯盏，朝太吾拱手一礼，<NL>声音如秋日溪流般平缓：<NL>“时节不等人，但情谊可期。有劳太吾此番相助。<NL>你我就此别过，待到下一个白露轮回，老朽仍在此地，静候故人，<NL>再共叙这掬露烹茶的清味。”

f27c9b71-d1df-4d07-b9e8-c77cc9ddc73f/Eve.en: The gathering is complete, and there seems to be some gain...
f27c9b71-d1df-4d07-b9e8-c77cc9ddc73f/Eve.cn: 采摘结束，似乎有所收获……
f27c9b71-d1df-4d07-b9e8-c77cc9ddc73f/Eve.ru: Сбор завершен, и, похоже, есть какая-то выгода...

692c06f4-9986-43bc-9e09-8be439849dc7/Eve.en: Seeing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> approach, the elder's eyes light up. He rises with a teapot and speaks earnestly: <NL>"You come at the perfect time! As the old saying goes, 'Dew turns white from this night on,' yet White Dew has its gradations...<NL>I wish to brew an authentic White Dew tea, which requires collecting three kinds of Qi. Feeble with age, I dare ask for your help..."
692c06f4-9986-43bc-9e09-8be439849dc7/Eve.cn: 长者见<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>前来，双目一亮，执壶起身，言语恳切：<NL>“来得恰逢其时！古语云‘露从今夜白’，然这白露亦有等差……<NL>老朽欲煎地道白露茶，需集三种性气，年迈力衰，敢请君相助……”
